faq: Which email service will send the messages?
Whichever you already use, such as Postmark, SendGrid, Amazon SES or Resend. If you have none, we suggest a low-cost option and set it up in your account.
Do you add push notifications for phones?
Not in these packages. Browser and mobile push have extra platform rules. Tell us in the order form if you need them and we quote it separately.
Will users get too many emails?
We help you choose events carefully, add digests and let users switch types off. Emails include an unsubscribe or preference link where the rules require it.
Can you write the notification text?
Yes. We draft short, clear messages for each event in your tone, and you approve them. Changing the wording later is a simple edit that we show you how to make.
